My research investigates the universe's code-theoretic and geometric structure, spanning quantum gravity, non-abelian gauge theory, quasicrystalline spin foams, topological quantum computing, and energy-efficient computation. I focus on mathematical and computational models that unify physical law and information—paired wherever possible with open-source verification scripts.

An independent direction connects the Riemann Hypothesis with prime-power sums, Fibonacci geometry, and adelic arithmetic.
